subject: Re: Kickoff: sparse convnets on-device track
body:
Zofia — resourcing.

Staffing: Vera 40% (heavily committed elsewhere in June, so her model-validation work front-loads into May), Freya 50%, Nikhil 40%, Paloma 50%.

Device lab: two weeks of exclusive time on the Snapdragon rigs in May — booked. Compute for retraining sparse variants: 32 A100s best-effort, fine on titan.

The biggest new line item is the human-rating study: there's no shared tool for side-by-side image-classification ratings, so we're scoping and building a human-rating annotation UI from scratch. Paloma has the design doc — roughly six engineer-weeks covering rater queues, pair presentation, and agreement stats — targeting a working tool by mid-June for a July rating round. Raters come through the vendor pool Nadia's PMO manages.

Flag if six weeks feels heavy, but I'd rather own the tool than bodge spreadsheets.

Alina
